page_title: How to use Webpack with React: an in-depth tutorial

summary.title: How to use Webpack with React: an in-depth tutorial
summary.one_liner: You learn to set up a React 16 and React Router 5 app with Webpack 4, Babel 7, hot module replacement, CSS Modules, and code splitting by route and vendor.
keywords: how do i set up webpack for react
takeaways: Configure Babel with preset-env and preset-react via .babelrc, and wire it into Webpack with babel-loader.
Set up Webpack 4 entry, output, devtool, module rules for JS and CSS Modules, plugins, and webpack-dev-server.
Enable hot module replacement with react-hot-loader and webpack.HotModuleReplacementPlugin.
Split code by route using dynamic imports with react-imported-component, and split vendor code using optimization.splitChunks.
summary.summary: This freeCodeCamp tutorial, updated for Babel 7, walks through building a small Hello World React app with React Router, Semantic UI, and Webpack 4 from scratch. It covers installing dependencies, writing .babelrc and webpack.config.js, and configuring CSS Modules with camelCase class names. It then adds hot module replacement, code splitting by route with a delayed loading spinner, and vendor splitting via splitChunks. The page ends by starting a production configuration, and the rest of that section was cut off in the provided text.
